name: Seismic Shock
description:
A wave of seismic force sweeps out from you. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against each creature within short range. On each failure, the creature takes 2d8 damage and is pushed 10 ft away from you. On each pass, the creature takes half damage and is not pushed.

Additionally, unsecured objects within short range are automatically pushed 10 feet away from you, and the spell emits a loud rumbling that is audible out to far range.

Describe the shock.
